meaning:
ταλαιπωρέω, -ῶ
(ταλαίπωρος), [in LXX Chiefly for שָׁדַד pu. ;]
1. to do hard labour, suffer hardship or distress: Jas.4:9.
2. In cl. occasionally trans., to weary, distress (so Psa.17:9, Isa.33:1).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to gloom.
